title: Filipino-Style Hash Browns
description: A crispy and flavorful side dish inspired by Filipino cuisine, made with shredded potatoes and onions.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, onion, and garlic.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the potato mixture to the skillet and flatten it with a spatula.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to break up the hash browns into smaller pieces.
Serve the hash browns hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
